note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Times are fictional labels. The mark on the clock is a supplied milestone only; the scene shows the supplied order of the events relative to it and never states what follows from a response being before or after it.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional proposal to supply chairs. The proposal arrives; Party B sends the response, which, as supplied, is sent and received before the supplied milestone; the clock reaches its mark at the last station. The hold shows the supplied state: response before the supplied milestone (as supplied).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a garden-services proposal between different parties, with all five events; the supplied milestone comes before the response is sent and received, so the clock reaches its mark mid-sequence and moves on. The hold shows: response after the supplied milestone (as supplied).

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, roles, references and time labels, three terms, all five events (the milestone between the response's sending and its receipt) and two annotations; the hold brackets the time sequence as to be examined. Standing coordinator rule item 20 (caps with the true reason). The pre-cap values are kept in LAW-0453.presets.precap.json. Each capped field was restored alone to its pre-cap value on top of the shipped preset and rendered (layout verdict, text px, smallest rendered head at the hold): proposal reference 13 -> 16 characters: 1:1 places no annotation next to its target (place-note0). Proposal title 28 -> 76: 9:16 place-note0; 1:1 has no layout (the taller proposal card makes the racks too tall for the hands to reach; 16.1 px, heads 50.8 px, flagged). Item term 20 -> 52, quantity term 12 -> 38, delivery term 13 -> 39: each fails 9:16 and 1:1 with place-note0. Second annotation 31 -> 40: 1:1 places neither the clock's caption nor the first annotation (place-clocknote, place-note0). With every capped field restored: no layout in any ratio. The response reference and text, the first annotation, names, roles, time labels and every count (3 terms, 5 events, 2 annotations) are not capped; every capped value stays longer than baseline. Shipped: 16:9 19.6 px, heads 91.7 px; 9:16 16.1 px, 72.6 px; 1:1 16.1 px, 60.3 px (rendered, at the hold).
